title: Experimental and Machine Learning Study of a Modified Cymbal Piezoelectric Energy Harvester.
summary: Fabricated bridge-like PVDF cymbal harvester, tested 5–1000 Hz; SVD/metamodel predicts resonance voltage and response from geometric inputs and is evaluated against experiments. The result is reported in Micromachines. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
